notes: Faces right, anchor = feet. slash: crouch windup (hold f2), two quick slashes, front knife f4 then back knife f6. lunge: coils f0-3 (telegraph f3: eye flare + bared fangs), launches f4, airborne knife-first f5-6 (drawn in place ~4px above the floor; the engine carries it forward ~40-60px over f4-f6), lands f7. emerge: f0 only the legs show at the top of the frame (dropping out of a portrait hung above), f1 falling, f2 lands in a crouch (dust), f3 hold, f4-5 rise; spawn it with its anchor on the floor under the portrait. walk: planted foot travels 3px per 110ms frame (~27 px/s). death: crumbles into ash and a blood pool; last frame is only the pool.
